text:
maria: hitting a flake in sampleapp streaming — when token refresh occurs mid-stream we sometimes see a 2nd partial chunk inserted before the final newline, producing bad JSON and the client drops the whole event. repro steps below.

kevin: ugh. any logs? which client? browser or node?

maria: node sample-app (v0.9.4), auth rotation via refresh endpoint. log shows two data lines where the second starts with "data: ," and timestamp but has leftover prefix from previous chunk. paste:

maria: ```
data: {"delta":"hello "}
data: {"delta":"world"}

```

anya: hmm looks fine? where's the bad part

maria: the bad sequence is:

maria: ```
data: {"delta":"foo"}
retry: 100
data: ,{"delta":"bar"}

```

kevin: oh the stray comma before { indicates a partial boundary. maybe auth refresh caused the last fragment to be flushed mid-frame.

samir: could also be chunk boundary alignment on proxy (nginx) + gzip. any upstream chunking headers? try disabling http chunked encoding in sampleapp.

[dev-bot]: deploy 2765432120 to staging completed :rocket:

anya: can you repro with curl -N ? also try forcing keepalive: `Connection: keep-alive` and ensure `Last-Event-ID` handled.

maria: repro steps i used: 1) start sampleapp 2) open stream 3) trigger refresh by expiring token 4) send ~100ms large completion. attaching minimal repro gist: https://gist.github.com/abc123

kevin: quick fix idea: when auth rotation happens, drain buffer and emit explicit newline delimiter before swapping connection. also add a small debounce on flush (25ms). worth trying.

maria: testing both now.

maria: quick results — debounce 25ms + explicit newline fixed for node sampleapp, but browser still shows orphaned comma in ~1/1000 runs.

anya: can you capture tcpdump? might be kernel coalescing weirdness.

maria: capturing now, will paste pcap.

samir: let's add a library-level parser tolerance: ignore leading punctuation before JSON object when parsing event data. log a metric and fail loudly in dev mode.

kevin: ok I'll draft a PR to sdk-parser to strip leading non-{ characters up to first `{` for SSE data. flag behind env var `SSE_LOOSE_PARSING=true`.

maria: thanks. filing ticket INF-4823 for invariant tests + sampleapp repro.

anya: note: this workaround could mask real protocol errors; keep strict by default.

maria: agreed. will add integration test and note in changelog.

samir: also add note in onboarding docs to set `bufferedFraming: true` in ngrok/proxy configs.

maria: awesome, i'll update sampleapp and close once tests pass :thumbsup:

kevin: ping me when PR is up, I'll review.

maria: will do — thanks all!
